Standalone DOCX extraction using extract

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"filename\":\"fake.docx\",\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/docx/fake.docx\"}")
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
